declarations.description: Manages repeatable groups in an open shadow root with native ElementInternals form participation. Adopts a cached snapshot of accessible page stylesheets; does not inject a color palette.
declarations.name: FormRepeatableElement

members.name: resetGlobalStyles
members.description: Clears the page-stylesheet cache for future instances; existing shadow roots are not refreshed.

members.name: formResetCallback
members.description: Restores field defaults and synchronizes the form value.

members.name: formDisabledCallback
members.description: Updates the disabled state of fields and generated buttons.

events.name: form-repeatable:added
events.description: Bubbling, composed event after adding a group. Detail contains group and groupCount.

events.name: form-repeatable:removed
events.description: Bubbling, composed event after removing a group. Detail contains the removed group and remaining groupCount.

attributes.name: remove-label
attributes.description: Visible Remove label, also combined with the group's first label or legend to name its action.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Positive integer minimum. Remove buttons are hidden at or below it; initial groups are not padded to meet it. Invalid values warn and fall back to 1.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Optional parsed integer limit greater than min. Add is hidden at that limit; unparseable or too-small limits warn and are ignored.

cssParts.name: group
cssParts.description: Group wrapper using subgrid across both columns.

cssParts.name: content
cssParts.description: Authored fields in the first column.

cssParts.name: group-controls
cssParts.description: Per-group Remove controls in the second column.

cssParts.name: controls
cssParts.description: Shared part on the main Add container and per-group control containers.

cssParts.name: button
cssParts.description: Both native Add and Remove buttons.

cssParts.name: remove-button
cssParts.description: Native Remove buttons with contextual accessible names.

declarations.name: defineFormRepeatable
declarations.description: Guarded registration helper. Importing this module also attempts automatic registration.

return.description: False without a usable registry; true if defined or already registered.
